coverage_gaps.description: The three highest-value channels in this cell (SeeNews, Central Banking, Bloomberg) are wholly or partly paywalled, and STA's full wire is subscription-only.

brief: Slovenian banking and payments people-moves reach English readers through a narrow, well-defined relay: SeeNews and STA English do the bulk of the translating, The Slovenia Times and bne IntelliNews add narrative context, and parent-group newsrooms (Intesa Sanpaolo, OTP Group, NLB's int-en investor stream) are frequently the true upstream that the aggregators re-report. The payments trade press this cell hypothesised - Finextra, The Paypers, FinTech Futures, IBS Intelligence - proved low-yield for Slovenia specifically; the only genuine dedicated regional people-moves column found is CEE Legal Matters' 'On The Move', which skews legal and compliance. Access, not existence, is the binding constraint: SeeNews, Central Banking, Bloomberg and the full STA wire are paywalled, while FinTech Futures (403) and Total Slovenia News (525) resisted a plain fetch and remain unverified rather than dead. Slovenian-language searching confirmed the relay is one-directional - sl-language results resolve to domestic media, so this cell should monitor the English re-publication layer and leave local-language origination to the local-media cell.
